name: primitives-texts-rolling
title: Rolling Text
blurb: Text characters roll vertically like a flip clock.
description: Each character animates upward through the alphabet or digit set before settling on the target character.
use_when: Score displays, counters, or time-based elements.
avoid_when: Reading new text — the roll-up animation masks content during transition.
a11y: Text is readable after animation settles but hidden during the roll.
